verdict.summary: The cache is correctly keyed by the full normalized (graph, scope) value, so hash collisions cannot cross-serve masks; normalization preserves the visibility predicate; unmasked forks preserve the prior dataset shape; and cache invalidation covers both authorization rematerialization and successful or potentially partial in-place data updates. The integration tests exercise the real authorized update path, stale INSERT/DELETE behavior, post-write masking, warm/cold oracle equivalence, and distinct-scope isolation. The cache remains feature-gated, bounded, and dependency-neutral, and the documentation consistently labels work-box measurements non-canonical.
